financing.summary: Century Communities (NYSE: CCS) funds itself with two $500M senior unsecured notes series (3.875% due 2029, 6.625% due 2033), a $1.2B senior unsecured revolver agented by U.S. Bank (upsized and extended to November 2030 on 2026-09-30) and retained equity of about $2.6B; mortgage repurchase lines fund Inspire Home Loans and secured bank construction loans fund the Century Living apartment arm. It held 60,969 lots at 2026-09-30, 45.1% controlled through option contracts with land sellers and developers, backed by only about $85M of deposits. Management said on the Q3 2026 call that it uses land banking only on a very limited basis, does not cross-collateralize deals, and is moving toward lower-deposit control structures; no land banker is named in the filings or releases read. Leverage is rising: revolver borrowings went from $51.5M at year-end 2025 to $456.0M at 2026-09-30, net homebuilding debt to net capital went from 25.9% to 34.9%, and the roughly $160M HistoryMaker Homes purchase on 2026-10-07 was funded on the revolver. Management's stated priority is to hold or reduce debt to capital over the next couple of quarters, which is the opening for off-balance-sheet lot financing, particularly for the expanded Dallas-Fort Worth pipeline.
financing.land_strategy: Mixed, leaning toward options. The FY2025 10-K lists 'favoring lot option contracts to optimize returns and manage our risk to land holdings' as a strategic priority and says land is generally bought for cash, in bulk or through option contracts; no percentage target or years-of-supply target is stated. Local management sources land and the corporate office approves acquisitions above set limits. Century Communities brand lots range from entitled land needing development to finished lots; Century Complete typically buys lots ready for permits. In 2025 the company cut its pipeline hard: controlled lots fell 41.8% (44,876 to 26,116) and total lots fell from 80,632 to 60,916, with $11.2M of option-termination charges. Controlled lots have since grown again to 27,496 (45.1%) at 2026-09-30.

lots.source_title: Century Communities Q3 2026 results press release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 2026-10-28)
lots.note: Company terms are 'owned' (54.9%) and 'controlled' (45.1%). Year-ago: 62,239 total, 36,483 owned, 25,756 controlled. Recent path: 80,632 (2024-12-31), 60,916 (2025-12-31), 58,537 (2026-03-31), 60,128 (2026-06-30). years_supply is derived, not company-stated: 60,969 lots divided by 9,991 trailing-twelve-month home deliveries (10,387 in FY2025 less 7,357 in 9M 2025 plus 6,961 in 9M 2026). Figures are before the HistoryMaker Homes acquisition of 2026-10-07; the HistoryMaker lot count was not disclosed. Segment-level lot table is an image in the 10-K and was not readable.

land_banking.description: Sister land development company of HistoryMaker Homes (Mitchell family, Grapevine TX); not acquired. Jabez will finish land development on select Century communities in Dallas-Fort Worth, and the two expect to pursue further DFW land opportunities together. On the Q3 2026 call the CEO described it as an ongoing contractual relationship.
land_banking.source_title: Company press release 2026-10-08: Century Communities Triples Dallas-Fort Worth Footprint with Acquisition of HistoryMaker Homes
land_banking.note: No financial terms, lot counts or option structure disclosed. ONM Living (the family's build-to-rent company) also stays independent.

land_banking.counterparty: Land bankers (not named by the company)
land_banking.description: On the Q3 2026 earnings call the CEO said land banking is used only on a very limited basis, that deals are not cross-collateralized, and that off-balance-sheet exposure through land banking is minimal. The FY2025 10-K names no land banker; its only reference is a risk factor saying option counterparties, 'possibly including land banks', could fail to honor contracts.
land_banking.source_title: Century Communities Q3 2026 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool, 2026-10-28)
land_banking.note: Counterparty identities and program size are not publicly disclosed. Statement is from a third-party transcript; the 10-K risk-factor reference was read directly.

land_banking.counterparty: Third-party land sellers and developers (option and purchase contracts)
land_banking.description: Controlled lots are held through option and purchase agreements with unrelated parties, usually with non-refundable deposits. Non-refundable option deposits were $74.2M at 2025-12-31 (up from $54.7M) and are the company's maximum loss exposure; no land seller is consolidated as a VIE. Management cited more than 27,000 optioned lots secured by about $85M of deposits (about 3% of equity) at 2026-09-30.
land_banking.source_title: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 1 Summary of Significant Accounting Policies (EDGAR page R10)
land_banking.note: amount_usd_m is the non-refundable deposit balance at 2025-12-31 (10-K). The lot count (27,496) is at 2026-09-30 from the Q3 2026 release; the $85M deposit figure is from the Q3 2026 call transcript (Reported). About $3,100 of deposit per controlled lot (derived). Aggregate remaining purchase price under option was not found in the pages read. Option abandonment charges: $11.2M in 2025, $2.3M in Q3 2026.

ma.counterparty: HMH Lifestyles, L.P. (dba HistoryMaker Homes), Grapevine, Texas
ma.description: Bought substantially all assets and assumed certain liabilities of HistoryMaker Homes, a five-generation family-owned Dallas-Fort Worth production builder founded in 1949 (CEO Nelson Mitchell). Initial cash consideration about $160.2M, subject to holdbacks and closing adjustments, funded on the revolver. Announced 2026-10-08. Vestra Advisors advised the seller. Sister companies Jabez Development (land development) and ONM Living (build-to-rent) were not acquired.
ma.map_impact: Adds 29 active communities to the Texas segment; pro forma, the Dallas division goes from 12 to 41 communities and from 211 to 669 trailing-twelve-month deliveries. Century's DFW operations and HistoryMaker combine into one division based in Grapevine, with HistoryMaker division leadership joining Century (leader not named in the release), so the DFW division president and land contacts may change. HistoryMaker drops out as an independent builder. Jabez Development becomes a named DFW land development partner. Lots acquired were not disclosed, so the 60,969 lot count understates the current position. About 100 HistoryMaker deliveries are in 2026 guidance.
ma.source_title: Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, Note 1 Basis of Presentation incl. subsequent event (EDGAR page R8)
ma.note: Price and community count from the 10-Q subsequent-event note; background and Jabez relationship from the company press release of 2026-10-08; division pro forma figures and 'tenth acquisition since the 2014 IPO' from the Q3 2026 call transcript (Motley Fool). Purchase price allocation not yet available.
